energy-redox: a brass laboratory balance tipping between a glowing bundle of glucose-like crystals and a cluster of small iron and sulfur mineral nuggets, with a column of sparks rising like a ladder between them, an allegory of electrons falling down an energy ladder

macromolecules: a botanical-style arrangement of the molecules of life: a coiled protein alpha-helix ribbon, a folded protein shaped like a curled leaf, a short curved strip of lipid bilayer drawn as a double row of round heads with paired wavy tails, and a short chain of three glucose sugars each drawn as a six-membered chair-shaped ring containing one oxygen atom, linked by single oxygen bridges, no benzene rings
enzyme-kinetics: a large folded enzyme drawn as a sculpted rounded mass with a deep cleft, a small substrate molecule settling into the cleft like a key into a lock, and two product fragments drifting away on the other side
